rich_narrative.summary: The Muslim Community Center – East Bay (MCC East Bay) serves as a central religious and social hub for the American Muslim community in Northern California. Founded in <cite id="1">2008</cite>, the organization focuses on fostering an American Muslim identity through a mix of spiritual, educational, and social service programs. Its operations are significant in scale for a local community center, reporting <cite id="2">$2,187,315 in total revenue</cite>. The organization provides essential direct services, including a <cite id="3">food pantry, refugee support, and zakat assistance</cite> for those in need. However, donors should approach the current financial assessment with care. No financial filings newer than FY2023 are available — donors should treat this <cite id="4">3-year-old financial picture with caution</cite> as it may not reflect the charity's current health. While the organization demonstrates high internal efficiency, spending <cite id="5">85.0% of its budget on programs</cite>, the lack of recent public filings and formal outcome tracking presents a balanced picture of high community value paired with transparency gaps.
